data.body: **P2:** Entering `DRAINING` before `validateRunningThreads()` prevents an already-started map/parallel coordinator from submitting its pre-created queued branches. For example, if a handler returns after starting a bounded `mapAsync`, the coordinator being awaited here receives `RejectedExecutionException` when it starts the next iteration, after the execution output has already been selected as successful. Drain admitted operation trees before closing task admission, or permit task submissions for operations registered before draining, and cover this with a `maxConcurrency(1)` integration test.
